entries.0f9b0f73c90da987: Apple Inc. (52.7% of sales results for the fiscal year ended September 2025) and Google Inc. (10.4% for the same period).
entries.158d8d641db593cd: This covers the planning and operation of the freemium manga apps "Manga BANG!" and "Manga Tote" and the Web e-book service "Manga BANG Books," and manga production under the label "Manga BANG Comics." The overseas version "MANGA BANG!" is handled by Amazia Link Inc., and WEBTOON production by the non-consolidated subsidiary WithLinks Inc. "Manga BANG!" is free in principle and rests on 2 models: a "per-episode payment plus advertising revenue model," earning revenue from small payments for 1 episode at a time and from advertising, and a "purchase model (store)," in which e-books are bought 1 book at a time. The securities report does not state this business's sales on its own.
entries.2817dd4b398643e7: Operation of "PetWalk", an app released by Amazia Link Co., Ltd. in August 2025, in which users earn points for posting pet photos and for actions on advertisements, and can exchange the points for cash, electronic money and other items.
entries.3620a29cf307a487: Amazia Link Co., Ltd. released and operates "LogsFix", a recruitment-related information service, in October 2024, and "Manga BANG Magazine", an entertainment-related information service, in September 2025 under a business partnership with Ranku-o Co., Ltd. Through the media sites, it delivers results such as purchases of or registrations for advertisers' products and services, and earns revenue when a result occurs. The securities report says "LogsFix" is struggling to get started.
entries.53e861fd71f8713e: Apple Inc. (52.7% of sales results for the fiscal year ended September 2025) and Google Inc. (10.4% for the same period). Both are platform operators responsible for app distribution and billing, and the securities report states that these sales results are the total amount of usage fees from users of the paid-content services that the Group provides through such companies
entries.56ef41c882907acf: This is the operation of the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo," started in February 2025, which sells trading cards, figures, plastic models, pin badges, plush toys and other items to overseas customers. The securities report states that sales are small and the business is at its launch stage, and also states that monthly sales exceeded ¥10 million and the business got off to a good start. Sales of this business are not stated on their own.
entries.676b3d41f62f2888: Business support through the provision of IT personnel (SES)
entries.7bab1c900ed76d2e: This reportable segment plans and operates the smartphone manga app "Manga BANG!," its Web version "Manga BANG Books" and the overseas manga app "MANGA BANG!," produces original manga, and operates the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo"; of the 2 reportable segments, it has the largest sales to external customers. Sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥2,792,398 thousand (down 22.1% year on year), and segment profit was ¥5,758 thousand (segment loss of ¥54,959 thousand in the previous year). The securities report states that reduced advertising expenses lowered MAU (monthly active users) and advertising revenue per unit, so both paid-content revenue and advertising revenue decreased, while sales of "Manga BANG Comics" rose 62.8% year on year and monthly sales of the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo" exceeded ¥10 million. With the start of the cross-border EC business in February 2025, the former "Manga App Business" was renamed to this name, and the cross-border EC business was consolidated into the same reportable segment.
entries.8fc99f7b0791a3cb: A reportable segment providing IT-related services such as SES (business support by providing IT personnel to client companies), operation of SEO media, and operation of a point-earning app, carried out mainly by Amazia Link Co., Ltd.
entries.aea04710a155d6f8: The "Wizumai Medical Online Clinic" operated by the consolidated subsidiary Wizumai Medical Co., Ltd. The securities report says that, as standards for medical-related advertising became stricter, expanding the business was judged to be difficult, and the service was ended in November 2025.
entries.b74f5f977b8045a0: A reportable segment providing IT-related services such as SES (business support by providing IT personnel to client companies), operation of SEO media, and operation of a point-earning app, carried out mainly by Amazia Link Co., Ltd. The business started in the fiscal year ended September 2024, and the securities report says the sales amount is small and the business is at the launch stage. For the fiscal year ended September 2025, sales were ¥50,777 thousand (segment sales of ¥550 thousand in the previous year) and the segment loss was ¥45,551 thousand (segment loss of ¥16,393 thousand in the previous year). The report says that in the SES business, personnel costs increased as hiring of personnel was actively pursued, but sales grew steadily.
entries.b85389e3741083d2: Operation of "PetWalk", an app released by Amazia Link Co., Ltd. in August 2025, in which users earn points for posting pet photos and for actions on advertisements, and can exchange the points for cash, electronic money and other items. Points are granted using part of the advertising fees the Group receives from advertisers, and the securities report says preparations are under way to expand the number of users.
entries.bf6fe29ec063ce10: Amazia Link Co., Ltd. released and operates "LogsFix", a recruitment-related information service, in October 2024, and "Manga BANG Magazine", an entertainment-related information service, in September 2025 under a business partnership with Ranku-o Co., Ltd.
entries.ca66e1d1427a3bc2: A company that provides the manga app "Manga BANG!" free of charge in its basic form and earns revenue from small in-app payments by readers and from advertising.
entries.cd8e3ecc48b30a73: A business started by Amazia Link Co., Ltd. in April 2024 that supports client companies' operations by providing IT personnel such as programmers and system engineers.
entries.ecf4c23c150cf0cc: Creation of original manga (label “Manga BANG Comics”), WEBTOON production
entries.ee3a1bea26430557: A business started by Amazia Link Co., Ltd. in April 2024 that supports client companies' operations by providing IT personnel such as programmers and system engineers. The securities report says it is a recurring-revenue business in which revenue arises according to the work of the IT personnel.
entries.fbf1010e64746bcf: The "Wizumai Medical Online Clinic" operated by the consolidated subsidiary Wizumai Medical Co., Ltd.
